name: 993 exhaust valves - F1 proxies
description: Non-functional parametric proxies of the Carrera and Turbo exhaust valves to compare packaging and mass between generic steel, Inconel 751 and Ti-6Al-4V, without concluding on engine suitability.

classification.intended_use: Preliminary thermal and dynamic simulation, comparative mass and packaging check only

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for code and record; no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: partworks - Stated dimensions of 993 exhaust valves
sources.notes: Carrera 109 x 42.5 x 8 mm; Turbo 108.9 x 43.5 x 8 mm, without full profile or tolerances.

sources.title: Special Metals - INCONEL alloy 751
sources.notes: UNS N07751 alloy developed for exhaust valves; bar and conventional manufacturing, not LPBF.

post_processing: stem, seat, groove and tip finishing
coating or hard-facing decision after tribology review

titanium.alloy: Ti-6Al-4V retained only as a deliberately challenged comparison for exhaust service
titanium.galvanic_isolation: seat, guide, retainer and coating compatibility must be reviewed

known_limits: The public dimensions do not define keeper grooves, seat angles and widths, margins, neck radii, coatings or tolerances.
Titanium is not selected for exhaust duty; it remains a comparison requiring measured temperatures and full thermal-fatigue validation.
The generated STLs are fit-check-only and must never be installed in an engine.
